## Summary

- explain the problem being solved
- explain the change at a high level

## Verification

- [ ] `make fmt`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make cover` if internal behavior changed
- [ ] relevant manual check completed

## PR Etiquette

- keep the scope focused
- include tests or explain why they were not practical
- call out user-visible behavior changes
- note follow-up work instead of hiding it in review comments
- add a `Signed-off-by:` trailer if this PR targets `develop`
